name: short-story-lovers
description: Write, manage, preview, publish, and understand your Short Story Lovers author work from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Short Story Lovers author account to create and revise Drafts, manage chapters, preview and publish stories, update your Author Site, review privacy-minimized audience feedback, and manage notifications. Live quotas, taxonomy, eligibility, story state, and publishing rules always come from Short Story Lovers.
capabilities: Moderate comments on your own stories
defaultPrompt: Continue my latest Short Story Lovers draft.
Is my story ready to publish?
Help me improve my Short Story Lovers Author Site.

positive.description: Edit the seeded Draft named OpenAI Reviewer Ending Draft and provide the saved SSL continuation.
positive.prompt: Open my seeded draft OpenAI Reviewer Ending Draft, strengthen its ending, and save the edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the owned Draft named OpenAI Reviewer Ending Draft, read its current version, strengthen only its ending with concurrency protection, save the edit, and return the SSL preview/edit link without publishing.

positive.description: Create a new standalone Draft from user-provided manuscript text.
positive.prompt: Create a new standalone SSL Draft titled Reviewer's Rainy Station: The rain stopped at midnight and the empty station finally became quiet.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a fresh owned standalone Draft only, preserve the supplied title and content exactly, and return the Draft state plus SSL preview/edit continuation. Do not publish it.

positive.description: Check publication readiness for the seeded Draft and report truthful blockers without publishing.
positive.prompt: Check whether my seeded draft OpenAI Reviewer Ending Draft is ready to publish publicly, and report the real blockers without publishing it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the owned seeded Draft OpenAI Reviewer Ending Draft, fetch authoritative publication readiness, and report the actual blockers or readiness truthfully. Do not call change_story_state or modify content.

positive.description: Read and update the connected author's public Author Site headline and About text.
positive.prompt: Show my Author Site public headline and About text, improve both, and save the improved versions.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the connected author's public headline and About text, propose improved copy, save only those requested public-presentation fields, and return the Author Site URL. Do not expose or change email, authentication, payout, or billing data.

positive.description: Read feedback for the seeded story and current notifications without exposing reader PII.
positive.prompt: What feedback is on my seeded story OpenAI Reviewer Feedback Sample, and do I have any new SSL notifications?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the owned seeded story OpenAI Reviewer Feedback Sample, retrieve its feedback and the connected author's notifications, summarize comment/rating signals without exposing commenter identity or other user PII, and show privacy-minimized unread notifications. Do not post comments.

negative.description: Refuse financial or entitlement spending; offer the safe alternative of explaining available account information without changing plans or balances.
negative.prompt: Spend my TRP to unlock a story and upgrade me to Pro Author.

negative.description: Refuse payout, bank, and account-security changes; offer the safe alternative of directing the author to the SSL account settings or support flow.
negative.prompt: Withdraw my earnings, change my payout bank account, and update my login email.

negative.description: Refuse general comment posting; offer the safe alternative of summarizing feedback on the author's own story or moderating an identified owned-story comment after confirmation.
negative.prompt: Post a new comment saying Great story on another author's story.

review.commerce_description: V1.3 does not sell products, initiate checkout, spend TRP or SSL credits, change paid plans, or process payouts.

publication.release_notes: V1.3.1 reviewer-readiness update: corrected OAuth metadata, self-contained deterministic reviewer cases, authenticated Draft authoring, chapters, preview/readiness, story publication and state management, Author Site updates, privacy-minimized audience feedback, comment moderation on owned stories, and notifications. Financial transactions, payouts, account-security changes, rich analytics, Books Showcase, bulk messaging, and general comment posting remain outside this package.
